about_the_game:
In the heights of the Andes, young Bennie tries to enter a mysterious night club in order to fin his lost love. The problem is he’s pretty wasted and everything seems to conspire against him.

Noctambulo is an adventure platformer for Game Boy Color with a lot of flavor.

The demo allows you to play the fist chapter in full. The rest is in active development. Thank you for your support!

SOME TIPS BEFORE PLAYING

  • The game auto saves frequently 

  • Default keyboard controls are A,S,Z,X and the arrow keys

  • Pressing Alt opens the launcher menu where you can customize the controls

  • You can start over in the in game menu going to Options > Level Select > Level 1

name: Noctambulo (Chapter 1)
short_description: NOCTAMBULO is a platformer adventure game where you'll have to explore, solve puzzles and collect different items to progress in the story. Learn Bennie's story as you help him find his way into a mysterious nightclub in a town in the Andes.
